incidents.name: Magic Transit Degraded Performance

incident_updates.body: This incident has been resolved.
The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

Cloudflare is currently investigating issues related to Magic Transit. A subset of Magic Transit customers have a Cloudflare-managed setting enabled that clears the Don't Fragment (DF) flag. For these customers, the setting is not currently taking effect. As a result, packets with the DF flag set and larger than the tunnel MTU may be dropped.
We advise customers to set an MSS clamp on their egress traffic in order to ensure ingress traffic is correctly sized.

incidents.name: Single-File Cache Purge Delays

incident_updates.body:
Cloudflare identified an issue that delayed a small subset of single file cache purge requests between 19:21 and 20:21 UTC on November 22, 2026. Affected requests were submitted through Cloudflare data centers in parts of Europe, the Middle East and Africa. For these requests, cached content in other Cloudflare data centers worldwide could remain stale for up to approximately 60 minutes before the purge completed. 

All delayed purges have since completed, and this incident has been resolved.
